newsitem.title: UK: Summary of new CBI UK economic forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Summary of new CBI UK economic forecasts.

text.p: Following is a summary of revised forecasts of British economic indicators by the Confederation of British Industry (CBI), published on Thursday (annual percentage changes unless otherwise stated, figures in brackets are the CBI's previous forecasts):

"With competitive pressures likely to remain intense, we consider that only modest upward moves in interest rates will be sufficient to contain inflation. This does not mean that a rise in interest rates is required now," said Kate Barker, chief economic adviser at the CBI."

# outturns using data from Office for National Statistics * Company profits are gross pre-tax trading profits of industrial and commercial companies, net of stock appreciation and excluding North Sea oil, and adjusted for inflation as measured by the GDP deflator. RPIX is retail prices excluding mortgage interest payments. ** PSBR data are for fiscal years.
